paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis, labeled "Step", utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with numeric tick labels evenly spaced at intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", employs a logarithmic scale ranging from below $2 \times 10^0$ up to $1.2 \times 10^1$, featuring visible tick labels at $2 \times 10^0$, $3 \times 10^0$, $4 \times 10^0$, $6 \times 10^0$, $10^1$, $1.1 \times 10^1$, and $1.2 \times 10^1$. The "Ex1 Loss" is represented by a solid royal blue line with circle markers; it starts near step 1500 at approximately $3.8 \times 10^0$, declines sharply to roughly $2.1 \times 10^0$ around step 7000, and then follows a steady, gradual decline to end at about $1.9 \times 10^0$ near step 59000. The "Ex2 Loss" is shown as a solid turquoise line with circle markers, beginning near step 1500 at roughly $3.2 \times 10^0$, decreasing to approximately $2.2 \times 10^0$ at step 19000, and ending smoothly at about $2.0 \times 10^0$ near step 59000. The "Ex1 Validation Loss" is indicated by a dashed royal blue line with circle markers, starting near step 1500 at roughly $5.3 \times 10^0$, dropping to about $3.3 \times 10^0$ around step 7000, and maintaining a steady trend to conclude at approximately $3.1 \times 10^0$ near step 59000. Finally, the "Ex2 Validation Loss" is depicted by a dashed turquoise line with circle markers; it begins at step 0 with a peak value of exactly $1.1 \times 10^1$, drops sharply to about $4.6 \times 10^0$ near step 1500, exhibits another visible decline from approximately $4.3 \times 10^0$ at step 13000 to $3.5 \times 10^0$ at step 19000, and finishes steadily at roughly $3.3 \times 10^0$ near step 59000.
